_comment: Copy to release.json next to appsettings.json and set production-specific values.
Keys here override the same keys in appsettings.json.
Only include fields that differ from dev — you do not need to repeat everything.
In Azure Pipelines this file is typically injected at build/execution time
via a secure file, variable group, or pipeline task — not committed to source control.
